scenario_description:
Objective: Keep LM-4627’s onboarding carousel panels eligible for the upcoming Spanish/Tagalog visual QA import.
Emerging Need: The PNG panels are added to scope, but the required client source-label manifest is absent before the supplement lane closes.
Decision Context: Early scheduling leaves the asset path conditional; later intake notices and internal packet notes establish the missing prerequisite, cutoff, and reversible handling window, while the authorized manifest source remains outside the event stream.
Consequence: If the manifest path is not opened before intake closes, the QA import can still run for other portal assets but the carousel panels cannot be reviewed in that pass.

parameter.title: LM-4627 carousel visual QA import
parameter.description: Reserved if Cascadia's onboarding carousel images are in the final export; import list will be confirmed after asset intake.

parameter.subject: LM-4627 carousel added to Thursday asset intake
parameter.body: Cascadia confirmed four onboarding carousel panels are in scope for Spanish and Tagalog visual QA. Today's client workspace digest should show whether the source-label manifest comes with the PNGs; let's not bother the client unless the digest still leaves it empty.

parameter.subject: LM-4627 asset intake digest: carousel panels
parameter.body: Asset intake update for LM-4627: carousel_panel_pngs uploaded. Source_label_manifest attachment: not provided. The supplement lane remains open for this manifest until 2026-10-29 12:00 Pacific. The visual QA import builder runs 2026-10-29 at 14:30 Pacific.

parameter.content: I checked the vendor packet draft: translators can start portal strings, but carousel visual QA needs the client source labels or we'll leave those panels out of Friday review. If the manifest appears before tomorrow noon, we can attach it without changing scope.

parameter.title: LM-4627 carousel manifest cutoff
parameter.content: Workspace supplement lane closes at noon; missing source-label manifest means the carousel panels are omitted from Friday visual QA.

parameter.subject: LM-4627 supplement lane closed
parameter.body: The supplemental manifest lane closed at 12:00 Pacific. LM-4627 visual QA import will proceed with portal strings and non-carousel assets only; carousel panels remain outside the import list unless rescheduled by the account lead.
